latest_release.name: Serein 1.0.0-nightly.20261113.90
latest_release.body:
## [1.0.0-nightly.20261113.90](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/compare/v1.0.0-nightly.20261112.87...v1.0.0-nightly.20261113.90) (2026-11-13)

### Features

* **desktop:** offer the steady refresh rate when G-SYNC is detected by [@dylanjkl](https://github.com/dylanjkl) in [#970](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/pull/970) ([8f6645d](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/8f6645d2142dfdb3c8126860e0c8db0cde4e1d4a))
* **i18n:** add Korean interface translations by StaK_P in [#980](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/pull/980) ([36c3db1](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/36c3db1fc4535a63dcba0cce677b034f8f13f24d))
* **livestream:** add ability to join livestream via preview, add current stream section and fix ui icons by João Oliveira in [#968](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/pull/968) ([acccd59](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/acccd59e0d39d8d94133836cd8e6dab73c017ad4))
* **network:** keep Discord's device state and warn before in-app captchas by dfrnoch ([92c7712](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/92c7712b8a52980785deaa72cbd465c34aa69bfc))
* **ui:** join a friend's voice channel from their profile by [@dylanjkl](https://github.com/dylanjkl) in [#971](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/pull/971) ([418ca96](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/418ca96e085f480fed030c2f86a6799ca4cb6abe))
* **voice:** show connection ping and RTT history by Nikita Morgun in [#982](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/pull/982) ([b72c73f](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/b72c73f2480441b478942091141ef37c710d2573))

### Bug Fixes

* **auth:** decide keyring absence in one check, including KWallet by dfrnoch ([d81262e](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/d81262eb1f7448e077d7da41873b0504e4f09165))
* **auth:** keep invite codes out of expiry route labels by dfrnoch ([38b2fb6](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/38b2fb63a53d21adb5419e2323c364c8ee59a38a))
* **auth:** keep tokens out of plain files when a keyring exists by dfrnoch ([c3d09b7](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/c3d09b7f00a4f3fd6c2be50118866cd390aace77))
* **auth:** report which response ended an expired session by dfrnoch ([536766b](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/536766bd10798b011b7ba35203d1c0ca2dd80a19))
* **auth:** require confirmed keyring absence for the plaintext fallback by dfrnoch ([5ab79d4](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/5ab79d4b241387d91ce0295e11340bdc731aabc0))
* **auth:** save logins to a private file only when no OS keyring exists by dfrnoch ([4dcf34b](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/4dcf34bf73f6c2ec61b7d5cbed119833cc31377a))
* **captcha:** solve challenges on the discord.com host by dfrnoch ([29a390c](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/29a390ce212342fe5c566ae7bf10ce9067c55cfa))
* **ci:** complete Korean catalog and bump rustix past RUSTSEC-2026-0486 by dfrnoch ([134a4b0](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/134a4b02edf1905c3d7d31f74fa05cfecd749fe0))
* **desktop:** keep attachment audio playing while the window is minimized by koloved in [#974](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/pull/974) ([0715e4b](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/0715e4b623e5bad84b303ea419fd8e8b99f9a54c))
* **network:** correct attachment verification and stop blocked traffic retries by David Frnoch in [#978](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/pull/978) ([dad25e0](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/dad25e0848a8a4703b6b52ded12e36d67ecde49f))
* **network:** refresh host identity and serialize rate-limit admission by David Frnoch in [#988](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/pull/988) ([abef23f](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/abef23ff3ecdb9fa8e40ebadf6773663829d1c5a))
* **packaging:** stop Linux packages pulling in a desktop environment by dfrnoch ([9f2fd70](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein/commit/9f2fd70ea9f6376415b2f9e0901f6b2d02f9002f)), closes [#986](https://github.com/ViceV
